title: Diamond I11 Project M: source-preserving contrast between Asp conditions
origin: Diamond Light Source I11, Project M, proposal EE15723-1, published dataset https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7871450; local XYE files and workbook verified by SHA256 baseline.

tension.description: Relationship between changed recorded condition and distinct XRD profile/fit outcomes.
tension.observed_change: Asp worksheet condition value 0 -> 0.1; two distinct source files.
tension.research_question: Can ODF retain the documented provenance of both profiles and their analytical outcomes?

description: Two XRD diffraction patterns from the Asp worksheet correspond to experimental-condition values 0 and 0.1. Silicon file is retained as a separately identified standard, with no asserted direct calibration link.

interpretation.description: Experimental-condition values and reported fit metrics differ. This run audits source relationships and does not infer a new physical phase, causal mechanism, or undocumented chronology.

notes: No physical rupture/emergence claimed; rupture list intentionally empty.
